hook_card.surface: Ink field, lime rule, compact kicker, one condensed display claim
hook_card.avoid: Do not add a logo bumper, greeting, or second idea to frame 0.

statline_scorecard.surface: Ink-dark scorecard with team-colored split header
statline_scorecard.hero_variant: One sourced number renders alone at 3x scale with pop; label above, source/date below.
statline_scorecard.avoid: Do not wrap every row in identical tiles; preserve the mirrored head-to-head structure.

chart_comparison.avoid: Do not use scorecard panels or decorative bars without an axis.

chart_timeline.avoid: Do not flatten a sequence into unordered comparison bars.

source_card.surface: Ink dossier with a clipped warm-paper citation insert
source_card.avoid: Do not style a citation like a data chart or imply a source supports claims beyond the cited statement.

chart_family.selection: The data question determines chart type; never render all comparisons as a single fixed chart.
chart_family.part_to_whole: Pie/donut only for an evidenced mutually exclusive whole, with 2-4 non-negative parts.
chart_family.time_series: Line only for ordered times/dates; preserve chronological order.
chart_family.comparison: Bar for ranking/long labels; columns for a small number of discrete categories.
chart_family.accessibility: Pair color with labels and direct values; expose source/date; retain a zero baseline for bars and columns.
